scientific_limitations: Exact finite-dimensional real symmetric positive-definite generators and a fixed surrogate; no variable model or inexact stage tolerance theorem.
One-stage perturbed implicit midpoint only, without correction stages; no nonlinear extension or unperturbed second-order accuracy claim.
Euclidean one-step norm contractivity is distinct from all-step spectral stability and inverse-generator energy contractivity.
A bibliographically equivalent historical matrix-norm or mixed-accuracy result cannot be ruled out definitively.
title: Sharp Euclidean stability ceiling for rank-one overdamping in perturbed implicit midpoint
